COASTAL · KENT · LISTING 04
The Cormorant House, a tide-watcher's retreat on Island Wall.

A four-bedroom Edwardian fisherman's house restored in 2022 with chalk-lime plaster, salvaged Suffolk oak, and a Vola fixture programme throughout. Owned by the studio since 2019; let to discerning travellers between March and November.

THE HOUSE
A measured restoration, three streets from the harbour wall.

Built in 1908 for a Whitstable oyster merchant and his family, The Cormorant House sat empty for the better part of a decade before Sable Echo took its keys in 2019. The brief was simple and unsentimental: keep what was honest — the brick, the floorboards, the cast-iron range — and let the rest go quietly.

What remains is a house that feels older than its renovation: lime-washed walls, a galley kitchen finished in Douglas fir, and a south-facing garden room added in 2022 by Margate practice Studio Holloway. Guests have the run of all four storeys, including a working library on the half-landing.

THE GARDEN ROOM, 7:00 A.M.
PLATE I
A room that reads the weather.

The garden room is a 14-square-metre addition glazed on three sides and roofed in handmade clay pantile. On still mornings the harbour fog gathers against its windows; by afternoon the light shifts north and the room becomes a studio. It is, the architect insists, the only honest place in the house to drink coffee.

Holloway Studio, 2022. Photographed for Cereal Magazine, Issue 22.

LIBRARY HALF-LANDING
PLATE II
The library belongs to whoever wakes first.

Built into the half-landing between floors, the library holds roughly four hundred volumes assembled over three years by the studio's founders — chiefly mid-century travel writing, Penguin Modern Classics, and a complete run of Slightly Foxed. Guests are welcome to borrow; we ask only that books return to roughly the right shelf.

Shelving by Aldworth James & Bond, London.

YOUR HOST
Hosted by Eleanor Whitfield since 2019.
EW
Eleanor Whitfield
Whitstable, Kent · Responds within 2 hours
Identity verified · Studio Host since 2019 · 142 stays hosted

Eleanor lives ten minutes away and meets every arriving guest at the door. She'll point you toward the better fishmonger, the quieter beach at Tankerton, and the wine merchant on Harbour Street who keeps an English-only list.

"The kind of house you write home from, not about. We left reluctantly, on a Tuesday, in rain."

— Hester & Paul, returning guests, March 2024

HOUSE POLICIES
A few quiet expectations.
CHECK-IN
From 4:00 p.m. Eleanor meets you at the door. Earlier arrivals possible with notice.
CHECK-OUT
By 11:00 a.m. We provide a packing-up list rather than a cleaning checklist.
CHILDREN
Welcome at any age. Travel cot, high chair, and stair gates supplied on request.
DOGS
One well-mannered dog considered. £40 supplement covers a deep-clean turnaround.
CANCELLATION
Full refund up to 30 days before arrival. 50% within 14 days. No refund inside 7 days.
QUIET HOURS
10:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m. The neighbours are kind, and we'd like to keep it that way.
